'''The destruction of Thanta Zilbra''' occurred when the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Thanta Zilbra (star)|Thanta Zilbra]] was destroyed by the [[Sacorrian Triad]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] using [[Centerpoint Station]]. This was observed by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] who was, at the time, helping evacuees escape from the star which they had been previously warned would explode.
